findings.message: River-volume segmentation is partially implemented but visible water and physics still diverge away from bridge. The fixed 22m-wide rectangular Area at z=-24 needs to be fully replaced with sampled/segmented volumes following _river_bank_pair().
findings.resolution: Complete the _build_meandering_water_volumes implementation and verify enter/exit at bridge and meander extrema.

findings.message: Opening composition still reads as sparse prototype. Forest mass begins too far behind river; close/mid-ground foliage and understory are insufficient to frame the opening as a layered, human-scale grove.
findings.resolution: Add coherent close/mid-ground foliage clusters outside route corridors and recapture the opening with bridge-to-forest child-height traversal.

findings.message: Photographic leaf textures on rounded low-poly canopy meshes remain visibly incompatible with toy silhouettes, striped trunks, ground textures, and character art style. This violates the cohesive material/asset-language gate.
findings.resolution: Replace with stylized foliage material compatible with existing mesh style, or swap trees with compatible textured models from Kenney/Quaternius packs.

findings.message: River reads as visually flat dark-cyan strip with hard shoreline edges. Shallow-bank/deep-channel and current cues are not legible in live third-person evidence.
findings.resolution: Strengthen visible shore/depth contrast and motion. Adjust DUDV mapping to show flow direction and vary color by depth.

findings.message: Bridge stairs and rails use generic collider boxes rather than matching collision geometry. Visual bridge mesh does not align with physical collision.
findings.resolution: Replace with authored dimensions or limited static mesh shapes for bridge collision. Add bidirectional CharacterBody3D physics traversal coverage.

findings.message: Wet-bank ribbon globally offset by 0.208m and floats above terrain outside flat opening. Visual bank props are not terrain-grounded.
findings.resolution: Terrain-ground the outer bank and lift only inner edge to water surface. Ensure visual-only riverbank props terrain-ground independently and test against imported terrain height.

findings.message: Default blue-uniform hero contradicts approved Ziemek/Gniewko direction. VS-046 must deliver concept-derived rig appearances.
findings.resolution: Blocked on VS-046: Requires rig-compatible authored garment/child-hero assets for both Ziemek (turquoise graphic hoodie, dark trousers, backpack) and Gniewko (light top, dark trousers) plus close and third-person captures.

findings.message: Safety ground collider must be retained until live terrain ray contacts prove spawn and bridge bank are backed by Terrain3D collision.
findings.resolution: Do not remove safety ground collider merely because Terrain3D rebuild was requested. Use session token mechanism (commit c602197) to prevent stale probes from disabling safety floor.

findings.message: Bridge coverage proves node existence only, not actual traversal. Deck/ramp seam, rail overlap, or terrain mismatch can block player while tests pass.
findings.resolution: Add bidirectional CharacterBody3D physics traversal coverage with live walk evidence from both bridge approaches.

findings.message: FillLight (0.62 intensity) is active throughout day and night without time-of-day responsiveness.
findings.resolution: Addressed: _update_adventure_fill_light() makes FillLight time-of-day responsive (energy 0.62/color cool blue at night, energy 0.24/color warm white at day). Night route readability capture still needed.

findings.message: Camera evidence still reads as flat dark river strip. Shallow/deep contrast and directional motion not visible from shore, bridge, and in-water viewpoints.
findings.resolution: Adjust water shader to show visible depth variation and current direction. Capture evidence from multiple viewpoints.

findings.message: Cyan foliage artifacts, broad empty lawn, incompatible asset families keep visual gate open.
findings.resolution: Replace cyan foliage with compatible stylized assets. Add foreground density and varied asset families to achieve natural opening composition.

findings.message: Normalized full-river UVs leave no legible flow pattern in bridge camera. DUDV mapping needs local/world meter derivation.
findings.resolution: Derive DUDV from local/world metres to create visible flow pattern. Retain temporal runtime evidence of water movement.

findings.message: Cosmetic vertex-wave amplitude may exceed fixed water-volume contact tolerance.
findings.resolution: Reduce or recalibrate vertex-wave amplitude to match physical water volume dimensions.

summary: VS-044 has made substantial progress with river-volume segmentation, forest clustering, and bridge collision improvements. However, the visual gate remains OPEN due to: (1) incompatible foliage material language, (2) incomplete river/physics cohesion, (3) sparse opening composition, (4) missing hero direction (VS-046 blocker), and (5) outstanding time-of-day lighting issues. Multiple HIGH severity findings must be addressed before this task can be approved. REQUEST_CHANGES with priority focus on visual asset cohesion and final composition capture.
blockers: VS-046: Hero asset creation (Blender) - child-proportioned rigs with Ziemek/Gniewko concept-derived appearances required
Visual art direction: Cohesive stylized foliage materials needed to match existing toy-style assets
Final composition: Layered grove/clearing with bridge-to-forest traversal not yet achieved
notes: Commend progress on forest cluster placement (z=-36,-37,-39,-40) and native GLTF bridge collision
Terrain3D session token mechanism (commit c602197) prevents stale collision probe issues
Water shader has DUDV flow and fragment channel depth but needs visible depth variation
All structural tests pass but visual acceptance gate remains the blocker
